mainEntity.name: How does B2B marketing work with MMC?

acceptedAnswer.text: We define a qualified lead with your sales team, build a site and landing pages that answer a buying group, connect your CRM and Meta CAPI, and optimise on cost per qualified lead every week. B2B cycles are long, so we plan for several touchpoints. Offers and qualifying questions aim at decision-makers rather than students or job seekers.

leaks.h2a: Five places a buyer slips away.
leaks.lede: A B2B sale takes several people and several weeks. Each stage below is a moment where a buyer can go quiet, and the service that keeps the conversation going.

stages.breaks: A buyer searches for the problem and finds your competitors.
stages.why: B2B buyers research alone before they contact any supplier, and shortlist from what they find. If you are not there while the problem is live, you are not on the list.
stages.does: We aim search and paid media at the queries buyers type when the problem is live, and build the SEO that earns visibility between campaigns.

stages.breaks: The site lists services but never says why you are the safer choice.
stages.why: A B2B purchase involves several people and real risk. Each needs proof they can forward: case studies, capabilities and answers to their objections.
stages.does: We build websites, case studies and creative that answer a whole buying committee, not just the first visitor.

stages.breaks: A contact page with a long form and no clear next step.
stages.why: Interested buyers rarely fill a long form for an unknown supplier. They want a demo, a call or a sample with little effort.
stages.does: We build landing pages and short forms around one next step, such as a demo or a call, and test them so more of your traffic becomes enquiries.

stages.tag: Lead generation, CRM and Meta CAPI
stages.breaks: Sales says the leads are poor, and marketing cannot show why.
stages.why: Optimised on form fills, platforms learn to find the cheapest enquiries, not the ones sales accepts. Volume rises while pipeline quality falls.
stages.does: We connect leads to your CRM and send the qualified, meeting-booked and won stages back to Meta through the Conversions API (CAPI), so campaigns learn what a good lead looks like.

stages.breaks: Leads go cold because nobody follows up in the first day, or after.
stages.why: B2B sales cycles are long. Most leads are not ready at first contact, and the supplier who keeps sensible contact is the one remembered when budget frees up.
stages.does: We build retention funnels of CRM-triggered email and WhatsApp follow-ups that keep a lead warm until sales is ready.

loop.h2a: How CRM and Meta CAPI make leads
loop.lede: A form fill tells Meta that someone showed interest, not that they were a good lead. Your CRM knows what happened next. The Conversions API (CAPI) carries that back to Meta.

steps.d: An ad brings a form fill or an enquiry.
Sales marks it qualified, meeting booked, proposal sent or won.

steps.k: CAPI sends the stage to Meta
steps.d: The stage goes back to Meta as a server-side event, not a browser guess.
The platform stops chasing cheap form fills and finds more people like the ones sales accepted.

loop.returnLabel: The next ads find more leads like the good ones

without.d: The platform sees only that a form was submitted. It finds whoever fills forms cheapest, and sales spends its week on leads that never fit.

with.d: The platform sees which leads sales accepted and which became customers. Spend moves toward that kind of buyer, and the cost of a qualified lead becomes the number to watch.
